item.title: Dell aims to give cloud RAN an edge boost, without Nvidia
item.description: New 'ruggedized' servers from Dell include Intel's latest silicon but no Nvidia GPUs.

item.title: Boost Mobile tests in-store sales of Starlink
item.description: Boost Mobile has launched a test program to sell Starlink's satellite broadband service in about 120 stores. The pilot has ties to EchoStar's pending sale of spectrum to SpaceX and builds on Starlink's growing retail strategy.

item.title: Nick Jeffery named COO of Charter Communications
item.description: Nick Jeffery, who served as CEO of Frontier Communications prior to its acquisition by Verizon, will join Charter Communications as chief operating officer in September. #pressrelease

item.title: TIM starts 'second journey' after situation normal is achieved, says CEO
item.description: Telecom Italia's Group CEO Pietro Labriola says the Italian operator's toughest job is 'starting now' after it meets full-year guidance for the fourth consecutive year.

item.title: Malaysia 5G realigns again as Telekom Malaysia jumps to U Mobile
item.description: Telekom Malaysia joins U Mobile's 5G network and leaves that of state-backed DNB, in another realignment of the country's 5G landscape.

item.title: Rakuten Mobile, Cape join US-Japan military exercise
item.description: US MVNO Cape and Rakuten demo critical communications via open RAN in latest US-Japan military readiness exercise. #pressrelease

item.title: Former Frontier CEO Nick Jeffery to join Charter as COO
item.description: Nick Jeffery, who led Frontier's successful turnaround and merger with Verizon, is set to become COO of Charter Communications, which is seeking ways to improve broadband results as it nears its merger with Cox Communications.

item.title: T Wholesale and Orange Wholesale lead Omdia's 15th Wholesale Innovation Analyzer
item.description: The Wholesale Innovation Analyzer is a landmark annual report that assesses disruptive advances in the global wholesale market. #pressrelease

item.title: TECNO unveils world's thinnest modular smartphone ecosystem concept
item.description: A new ultra-thin magnetic architecture makes a modular smartphone system possible without added bulk. #pressrelease

item.title: American Tower's exposure to Dish default is roughly $200M per year
item.description: American Tower estimates that Dish Wireless represented about 4% of North American property revenues in 2025, or roughly $200 million. The tower owner has filed a lawsuit as it looks to recover what it believes it is owed after Dish defaulted on rental payments.
